description: Build a scrubbable show timeline: a single Timer-CHOP playhead drives ordered scenes that recall cues on a target COMP. Sits above create_cue_sequencer (beat-quantized) and create_scheduler (event-firing) as the show's master clock. Exposes Play/Pause/Stop/Seek/Rate/Loop/Active_Scene custom pars + a playhead Null CHOP (t_seconds, t_norm, scene_idx, scene_t). Consumes the foundation setlist schema: when setlist_path is given, each scene's setlist_slot is mirrored into tdmcp_scenes for downstream tools. Bars→seconds conversion uses BPM 120 + 4 beats-per-bar at build time (no auto-rescale on tempo change).

autoplay.description: Pulse the Timer's start on cook when true.

loop.description: End of last scene → wrap to 0.

parent_path.description: Parent path where the engine COMP lives.

rate.description: Playback rate multiplier (Timer CHOP speed). Exposed as a live custom par.

scenes.description: Ordered scene list (sorted by `start` at build time). Overlaps drive morphs.

cue.description: Name of a cue stored on `target` via manage_cue. Recalled when the playhead enters.

duration.description: Length of this scene on the timeline, in `units`.

morph_in_seconds.description: Crossfade duration entering this scene from the previous one. 0 = snap.

name.description: Human label for the scene; used in the live control row + Active_Scene readout.

setlist_slot.description: OPTIONAL setlist slot id (resolved against `setlist_path`) for downstream cross-refs.

start.description: Start offset on the timeline, in `units` (seconds or bars).

setlist_path.description: OPTIONAL path to a DAT holding the foundation-setlist JSON. When present, scene.setlist_slot is stored alongside each scene in tdmcp_scenes for downstream tools.

target.description: COMP that owns the cues (tdmcp_cues). Store scenes' cues first with manage_cue.

units.description: Input unit for `start`/`duration`/`morph_in_seconds`. 'bars' is converted to seconds at build time using BPM 120 + 4 beats-per-bar (no auto-rescale on tempo change).
